description: This source file defines the Java entity class 'StaffAssignmentHistory', which models the historical assignment records of staff members to groups within the organization. It includes fields for associated group and staff, start and end dates of assignment, and utility methods for creation and updates.

classes.name: StaffAssignmentHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing the history of staff assignments to groups, with creation, update, and retrieval methods.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Factory method to create a new StaffAssignmentHistory instance with a specified center, staff, and start date.

methods.name: updateStaff
methods.description: Updates the staff member associated with this assignment record.

methods.name: updateStartDate
methods.description: Updates the start date of the assignment.

methods.name: updateEndDate
methods.description: Updates the end date of the assignment.

methods.name: matchesStartDateOf
methods.description: Checks if the given date matches the start date of this assignment.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the assignment.

methods.name: isCurrentRecord
methods.description: Determines if the record is current (i.e., end date is null).
